title: Drift
profTagline: A generative ambient engine — endless, never-repeating, mathematically consonant tracks composed live in the browser. Ten distinct worlds (deep-space drone, warm tape loop, crystalline glass, oceanic swell, zen pluck, cosmic choir, just-intoned tanpura, neo-classical strings, lo-fi dust, Lydian shimmer), ten swappable sound-packs, and three macros. Consonance by small-integer ratios, chords voice-led for a held-drone glue, Brian-Eno coprime loops so it never loops. All synthesised, no files, offline.
installDesc: Works offline, opens like an app
installIosHint: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
